text:
The federal court will likely grant the remand motion. Only a defendant may remove under 28 U.S.C. § 1441(a), so the note's claim that any party can remove is wrong, and the plaintiff's federal claims do not change that. The court may also award the employer fees and costs under § 1447(c) because the removal lacked an objectively reasonable basis, and the case will return to the state court where the judge is assigned.

CONFIDENCE: 90
